text: Lead decision (2026-09-28): the histogram fallback's bar heights may be computed in studio-viz as display binning of per-control values the backend already served. This is presentation, like placing dots: each bar is an aggregate PlotMark whose rows are exactly the controls it represents (Represented marking), so every bar traces to its rows through the TableTwin, and no statistic beyond a count of shown rows is derived. Bin edges must be declared (named, deterministic) and shown in the table/readout. If a bar ever needs a statistic (density, smoothing), it must come from the backend.
